routines.name: comment_is_whisper_thread
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.comment_is_whisper_thread(p_comment_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with recursive thread as (
    select c.id, c.parent_id, c.is_whisper, array[c.id]::uuid[] as path
    from public.character_comments c
    where c.id = p_comment_id
    union all
    select parent.id, parent.parent_id, parent.is_whisper, child.path || parent.id
    from public.character_comments parent
    join thread child on child.parent_id = parent.id
    where not parent.id = any(child.path)
  )
  select coalesce(bool_or(thread.is_whisper), false)
  from thread;
$function$

AS $function$
  select exists (

    from public.character_comments parent
    left join public.characters ch on ch.id = parent.character_id

routines.name: claim_chat_deletion_jobs
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_chat_deletion_jobs(p_limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS TABLE(job_id uuid, resource_type text, resource_id uuid, owner_id uuid, purge_after timestamp with time zone, attempt_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_limit integer:=LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit,10),1),50);
BEGIN
  IF COALESCE(auth.role(),'')<>'service_role' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT j.id FROM public.chat_deletion_jobs j
    WHERE j.purge_after<=clock_timestamp() AND j.attempt_count<8
      AND ((j.status IN ('queued','retry') AND (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at<=clock_timestamp()))
        OR (j.status='processing' AND j.lease_until<=clock_timestamp()))
    ORDER BY j.purge_after,j.created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT v_limit
  )
  UPDATE public.chat_deletion_jobs j
  SET status='processing',attempt_count=j.attempt_count+1,next_attempt_at=NULL,
      lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '5 minutes',updated_at=clock_timestamp()
  FROM candidates c WHERE j.id=c.id
  RETURNING j.id,j.resource_type,j.resource_id,j.owner_id,j.purge_after,j.attempt_count;
END;
$function$

routines.name: claim_chat_storage_deletion_jobs
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_chat_storage_deletion_jobs(p_limit integer DEFAULT 25)
 RETURNS TABLE(job_id uuid, deletion_job_id uuid, bucket_id text, object_path text, resource_type text, resource_id uuid, owner_id uuid, attempt_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_limit integer:=LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit,25),1),100);
BEGIN
  IF COALESCE(auth.role(),'')<>'service_role' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT sj.id FROM public.chat_storage_deletion_jobs sj
    JOIN public.chat_deletion_jobs dj ON dj.id=sj.deletion_job_id
    WHERE dj.status='completed' AND dj.purge_after<=clock_timestamp() AND sj.attempt_count<8
      AND ((sj.status IN ('queued','retry') AND (sj.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR sj.next_attempt_at<=clock_timestamp()))
        OR (sj.status='processing' AND sj.lease_until<=clock_timestamp()))
    ORDER BY sj.created_at FOR UPDATE OF sj SKIP LOCKED LIMIT v_limit
  )
  UPDATE public.chat_storage_deletion_jobs sj
  SET status='processing',attempt_count=sj.attempt_count+1,next_attempt_at=NULL,
      lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '5 minutes',updated_at=clock_timestamp()
  FROM candidates c WHERE sj.id=c.id
  RETURNING sj.id,sj.deletion_job_id,sj.bucket_id,sj.object_path,sj.resource_type,sj.resource_id,sj.owner_id,sj.attempt_count;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_encounter_evaluation_jobs(p_limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS TABLE(session_id uuid, user_id uuid, character_id uuid, turn_count integer, attempt_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_limit integer:=LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit,10),1),25);
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH candidate_sessions AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s.id FROM public.chat_sessions s
    JOIN public.encounter_session_lifecycle lifecycle ON lifecycle.session_id=s.id
    JOIN public.encounter_session_evaluation_jobs job ON job.session_id=s.id
    WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL AND lifecycle.status='ready_to_settle' AND lifecycle.scheduled_end_at<=clock_timestamp()
      AND job.attempt_count<5
      AND (job.status='pending' OR (job.status='failed' AND job.updated_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '5 minutes') OR (job.status='processing' AND job.claimed_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '10 minutes'))
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.chat_turn_charges charge WHERE charge.session_id=job.session_id AND charge.status IN ('created','reserved','needs_reconciliation'))
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.encounter_session_turns turn WHERE turn.session_id=job.session_id)=lifecycle.turn_count
    ORDER BY lifecycle.scheduled_end_at,job.session_id FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED LIMIT v_limit
  ),
  candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT job.session_id FROM public.encounter_session_evaluation_jobs job
    JOIN candidate_sessions cs ON cs.id=job.session_id ORDER BY job.session_id FOR UPDATE OF job SKIP LOCKED LIMIT v_limit
  )
  UPDATE public.encounter_session_evaluation_jobs job
  SET status='processing',attempt_count=job.attempt_count+1,claimed_at=clock_timestamp(),completed_at=NULL,last_error=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
  FROM candidates JOIN public.encounter_session_lifecycle lifecycle ON lifecycle.session_id=candidates.session_id
  WHERE job.session_id=candidates.session_id
  RETURNING job.session_id,job.user_id,job.character_id,lifecycle.turn_count,job.attempt_count;
END;
$function$

routines.name: create_encounter_session_with_lifecycle
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_encounter_session_with_lifecycle(p_session_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_character_id uuid, p_character_name text, p_character_snapshot jsonb, p_schedule_snapshot jsonb, p_location_key text, p_scheduled_start_at timestamp with time zone, p_scheduled_end_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_session jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF p_session_id IS NULL OR p_user_id IS NULL OR p_character_id IS NULL
     OR p_location_key IS NULL OR char_length(p_location_key) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 80
     OR jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(p_character_snapshot, '{}'::jsonb)) <> 'object'
     OR jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(p_schedule_snapshot, '{}'::jsonb)) <> 'object'
     OR pg_column_size(COALESCE(p_schedule_snapshot, '{}'::jsonb)) > 8000
     OR p_scheduled_start_at IS NULL OR p_scheduled_end_at IS NULL
     OR p_scheduled_end_at <= p_scheduled_start_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid Encounter session lifecycle input' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.chat_sessions (
    id, user_id, character_id, character_name, status,
    character_snapshot, session_data, chat_mode
  ) VALUES (
    p_session_id, p_user_id, p_character_id, p_character_name, 'active',
    COALESCE(p_character_snapshot, '{}'::jsonb),
    jsonb_build_object('encounter', jsonb_build_object('affinity', 0, 'relationshipStage', 'first_meeting')),
    'encounter'
  );

  INSERT INTO public.encounter_session_lifecycle (
    session_id, user_id, character_id, location_key, schedule_snapshot,
    scheduled_start_at, scheduled_end_at, timezone, status
  ) VALUES (
    p_session_id, p_user_id, p_character_id, p_location_key, p_schedule_snapshot,
    p_scheduled_start_at, p_scheduled_end_at, 'Asia/Taipei', 'active'
  );

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'id', s.id, 'user_id', s.user_id, 'character_id', s.character_id,
    'character_name', s.character_name, 'status', s.status,
    'character_snapshot', s.character_snapshot, 'session_data', s.session_data,
    'chat_mode', s.chat_mode, 'created_at', s.created_at, 'updated_at', s.updated_at
  ) INTO v_session
  FROM public.chat_sessions AS s WHERE s.id = p_session_id;
  RETURN v_session;
END;
$function$
routines.identity_arguments: p_session_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_character_id uuid, p_character_name text, p_character_snapshot jsonb, p_schedule_snapshot jsonb, p_location_key text, p_scheduled_start_at timestamp with time zone, p_scheduled_end_at timestamp with time zone

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_account_deletion_status()
 RETURNS TABLE(is_pending boolean, requested_at timestamp with time zone, scheduled_for timestamp with time zone)

routines.name: get_account_deletion_work_items
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_account_deletion_work_items()
 RETURNS TABLE(target_user_id uuid, batch_id uuid, scheduled_for timestamp with time zone, work_status text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT q.user_id, b.id, q.scheduled_for, COALESCE(b.status, 'due')::text
  FROM public.account_deletion_requests AS q
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ab.id, ab.status
    FROM public.account_deletion_archive_batches AS ab
    WHERE ab.target_user_id = q.user_id
      AND ab.requested_at = q.requested_at
      AND ab.scheduled_for = q.scheduled_for
      AND ab.status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled')
    ORDER BY ab.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS b ON true
  WHERE q.scheduled_for <= pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.account_deletion_archive_batches AS completed_batch
      WHERE completed_batch.target_user_id = q.user_id
        AND completed_batch.requested_at = q.requested_at
        AND completed_batch.scheduled_for = q.scheduled_for
        AND completed_batch.status = 'completed'
    )

  UNION ALL

  SELECT b.target_user_id, b.id, b.scheduled_for, b.status
  FROM public.account_deletion_archive_batches AS b
  WHERE b.status = 'deleting'
    AND b.target_user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.account_deletion_requests AS q
      WHERE q.user_id = b.target_user_id
        AND q.requested_at = b.requested_at
        AND q.scheduled_for = b.scheduled_for
    );
$function$

routines.name: get_character_comments_safe
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_character_comments_safe(p_character_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, character_id uuid, author_id uuid, content text, parent_id uuid, is_whisper boolean, is_deleted boolean, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone, is_redacted boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  WITH me AS (SELECT auth.uid() AS uid),
  ch AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.author_id AS character_author_id
    FROM public.characters c
    WHERE c.id = p_character_id
      AND (
        c.author_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
        OR (
          c.visibility = 'public' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND (c.is_nsfw IS NOT TRUE OR ((SELECT auth.uid()) IS NOT NULL AND private.current_user_is_adult()))
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT cm.id, cm.character_id, cm.author_id,
    CASE
      WHEN cm.is_deleted THEN '該筆評論已被刪除'
      WHEN private.comment_is_whisper_thread(cm.id)
       AND cm.author_id IS DISTINCT FROM me.uid
       AND ch.character_author_id IS DISTINCT FROM me.uid
       AND COALESCE(parent.author_id, cm.author_id) IS DISTINCT FROM me.uid
        THEN '這是一則悄悄話留言'
      ELSE cm.content
    END,
    cm.parent_id, cm.is_whisper, cm.is_deleted, cm.created_at, cm.updated_at,
    (NOT cm.is_deleted AND private.comment_is_whisper_thread(cm.id)
      AND cm.author_id IS DISTINCT FROM me.uid
      AND ch.character_author_id IS DISTINCT FROM me.uid
      AND COALESCE(parent.author_id, cm.author_id) IS DISTINCT FROM me.uid) AS is_redacted
  FROM public.character_comments cm
  JOIN ch ON ch.id = cm.character_id
  CROSS JOIN me
  LEFT JOIN public.character_comments parent ON parent.id = cm.parent_id
  WHERE cm.character_id = p_character_id
  ORDER BY cm.created_at ASC;
$function$

routines.name: get_character_turn_counts
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_character_turn_counts(p_character_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(character_id uuid, turn_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  WITH requested AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT unnest(COALESCE(p_character_ids, ARRAY[]::uuid[])) AS character_id
  ),
  allowed AS (
    SELECT c.id AS character_id
    FROM public.characters c JOIN requested r ON r.character_id = c.id
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND (
        c.author_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
        OR (c.visibility = 'public' AND (
          c.is_nsfw IS NOT TRUE OR ((SELECT auth.uid()) IS NOT NULL AND private.current_user_is_adult())
        ))
      )
  ),
  solo_counts AS (
    SELECT s.character_id, count(m.id)::bigint AS turn_count
    FROM public.chat_sessions s
    LEFT JOIN public.chat_messages m ON m.session_id=s.id AND m.role='assistant' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
    JOIN allowed a ON a.character_id=s.character_id
    WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY s.character_id
  ),
  group_counts AS (
    SELECT gm.character_id,count(gm.id)::bigint AS turn_count
    FROM public.chat_group_messages gm JOIN allowed a ON a.character_id=gm.character_id
    WHERE gm.speaker_type='character' AND gm.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY gm.character_id
  )
  SELECT a.character_id,COALESCE(sc.turn_count,0)+COALESCE(gc.turn_count,0) AS turn_count
  FROM allowed a LEFT JOIN solo_counts sc ON sc.character_id=a.character_id
  LEFT JOIN group_counts gc ON gc.character_id=a.character_id;
$function$

routines.name: get_latest_settled_encounter_affinity
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_latest_settled_encounter_affinity(p_character_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(session_id uuid, settled_at timestamp with time zone, affinity integer, relationship_stage text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  IF p_character_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Character ID is required' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT lifecycle.session_id,
         lifecycle.settled_at,
         (lifecycle.settlement_result->>'final_affinity')::integer,
         lifecycle.settlement_result->>'relationship_stage'
  FROM public.encounter_session_lifecycle AS lifecycle
  WHERE lifecycle.user_id=v_user_id
    AND lifecycle.character_id=p_character_id
    AND lifecycle.status='settled'
    AND lifecycle.settled_at IS NOT NULL
    AND jsonb_typeof(lifecycle.settlement_result)='object'
    AND (lifecycle.settlement_result->>'final_affinity') ~ '^-?[0-9]{1,3}$'
    AND (lifecycle.settlement_result->>'final_affinity')::integer BETWEEN -100 AND 100
    AND lifecycle.settlement_result->>'relationship_stage' IN (
      'hostile','dislike','wary','first_meeting',
      'acquaintance','close','intimate','special'
    )
  ORDER BY lifecycle.settled_at DESC,lifecycle.session_id
  LIMIT 1;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_private_profile_data()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_wallet_transaction_character_names()
 RETURNS TABLE(reference_id text, character_name text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT wt.reference_id,COALESCE(cs.character_name,cs.character_snapshot->>'name','未知角色') AS character_name
  FROM public.wallet_transactions wt
  JOIN public.chat_turn_charges c ON c.turn_id::text=wt.reference_id
  JOIN public.chat_sessions cs ON cs.id=c.session_id
  WHERE wt.user_id=auth.uid()
    AND wt.biz_type IN ('chat_turn_charge','chat_turn_refund')
    AND cs.user_id=auth.uid();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_public_character_turn_count(p_character_id uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT
    (SELECT count(m.id)::bigint FROM public.chat_sessions s
      LEFT JOIN public.chat_messages m ON m.session_id=s.id AND m.role='assistant' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
      WHERE s.character_id=c.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL)
    +
    (SELECT count(gm.id)::bigint FROM public.chat_group_messages gm
      WHERE gm.character_id=c.id AND gm.speaker_type='character' AND gm.deleted_at IS NULL)
  FROM public.characters c
  WHERE c.id=p_character_id AND c.visibility='public' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (c.is_nsfw IS NOT TRUE OR ((SELECT auth.uid()) IS NOT NULL AND private.current_user_is_adult()));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_story_relationship_state(p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(affinity integer, relationship_stage text, origin_mode text, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  IF p_session_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Story session ID is required' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT state.affinity,state.relationship_stage,state.origin_mode,state.updated_at
  FROM public.story_relationship_states AS state
  JOIN public.chat_sessions AS session
    ON session.id=state.session_id
  WHERE state.session_id=p_session_id
    AND state.user_id=v_user_id
    AND session.user_id=v_user_id
    AND session.chat_mode='story'
    AND session.deleted_at IS NULL;
END;
$function$

       WHERE r.user_id = OLD.user_id

routines.name: mark_chat_deletion_job_failed
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_chat_deletion_job_failed(p_job_id uuid, p_error_code text DEFAULT 'purge_failed'::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF COALESCE(auth.role(),'')<>'service_role' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.chat_deletion_jobs j
  SET status=CASE WHEN j.attempt_count>=8 THEN 'dead_letter' ELSE 'retry' END,
      next_attempt_at=CASE WHEN j.attempt_count>=8 THEN NULL ELSE clock_timestamp()+make_interval(mins=>LEAST(60,power(2,LEAST(j.attempt_count,6))::integer)) END,
      lease_until=NULL,
      last_error_code=COALESCE(NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(COALESCE(p_error_code,'purge_failed'),'[^a-zA-Z0-9:_-]','','g'),100),''),'purge_failed'),
      updated_at=clock_timestamp()
  WHERE j.id=p_job_id AND j.status='processing';
  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$

routines.name: mark_chat_storage_deletion_job
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_chat_storage_deletion_job(p_job_id uuid, p_success boolean, p_error_code text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF COALESCE(auth.role(),'')<>'service_role' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF p_success IS TRUE THEN
    UPDATE public.chat_storage_deletion_jobs SET status='completed',next_attempt_at=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error_code=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
    WHERE id=p_job_id AND status='processing';
  ELSE
    UPDATE public.chat_storage_deletion_jobs sj
    SET status=CASE WHEN sj.attempt_count>=8 THEN 'dead_letter' ELSE 'retry' END,
        next_attempt_at=CASE WHEN sj.attempt_count>=8 THEN NULL ELSE clock_timestamp()+make_interval(mins=>LEAST(60,power(2,LEAST(sj.attempt_count,6))::integer)) END,
        lease_until=NULL,
        last_error_code=COALESCE(NULLIF(left(regexp_replace(COALESCE(p_error_code,'storage_delete_failed'),'[^a-zA-Z0-9:_-]','','g'),100),''),'storage_delete_failed'),
        updated_at=clock_timestamp()
    WHERE sj.id=p_job_id AND sj.status='processing';
  END IF;
  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$
routines.identity_arguments: p_job_id uuid, p_success boolean, p_error_code text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_encounter_evaluation_job_completed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status='settled' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'settled' THEN
    UPDATE public.encounter_session_evaluation_jobs
    SET status='completed',completed_at=clock_timestamp(),claimed_at=NULL,
        last_error=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
    WHERE session_id=NEW.session_id;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

routines.name: prepare_account_deletion
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prepare_account_deletion(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(batch_id uuid, target_user_id uuid, batch_status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_requested_at timestamptz;
  v_scheduled_for timestamptz;
  v_batch_id uuid;
  v_status text;
  v_ai_source bigint;
  v_ai_archived bigint;
  v_wallet_source bigint;
  v_wallet_archived bigint;
  v_charge_source bigint;
  v_charge_archived bigint;
  v_event_source bigint;
  v_event_archived bigint;
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '目標帳號不可為空';
  END IF;

  SELECT r.requested_at, r.scheduled_for
    INTO v_requested_at, v_scheduled_for
  FROM public.account_deletion_requests AS r
  WHERE r.user_id = p_user_id
    AND r.scheduled_for <= pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '找不到此帳號已到期的刪除申請';
  END IF;

  -- Lock/reuse this exact request's batch. Never create a second active batch.
  SELECT b.id, b.status
    INTO v_batch_id, v_status
  FROM public.account_deletion_archive_batches AS b
  WHERE b.target_user_id = p_user_id
    AND b.requested_at = v_requested_at
    AND b.scheduled_for = v_scheduled_for
    AND b.status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled')
  ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF FOUND AND v_status = 'deleting' THEN
    -- The status change and relational cleanup commit in one PostgreSQL transaction.
    -- Therefore a committed deleting batch means cleanup already completed; do not
    -- compare now-empty source tables with their preserved archive row counts.
    RETURN QUERY SELECT v_batch_id, p_user_id, 'deleting'::text;
    RETURN;
  ELSIF FOUND THEN
    -- Backfill billing/audit snapshots for older batches created before these source
    -- tables were added to the archive. ON CONFLICT preserves any prior payload so the
    -- exact-payload checks below still fail closed on a conflicting existing snapshot.
    INSERT INTO public.account_deletion_archive_items
      (batch_id, source_table, source_record_id, payload)
    SELECT v_batch_id, 'chat_turn_charges', c.turn_id::text, pg_catalog.to_jsonb(c)
    FROM public.chat_turn_charges AS c
    WHERE c.user_id = p_user_id
    ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT account_deletion_archive_item_batch_id_source_table_source__key
    DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO public.account_deletion_archive_items
      (batch_id, source_table, source_record_id, payload)
    SELECT v_batch_id, 'chat_turn_events', e.event_id::text, pg_catalog.to_jsonb(e)
    FROM public.chat_turn_events AS e
    WHERE e.user_id = p_user_id
    ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT account_deletion_archive_item_batch_id_source_table_source__key
    DO NOTHING;

    -- A failed or interrupted archive can be retried only if every remaining source row
    -- is exactly represented in the existing archive. Any mismatch fails closed.
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_ai_source
    FROM public.ai_generation_records AS a WHERE a.user_id = p_user_id;
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_wallet_source
    FROM public.wallet_transactions AS w WHERE w.user_id = p_user_id;
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_ai_archived
    FROM public.account_deletion_archive_items AS i
    WHERE i.batch_id = v_batch_id AND i.source_table = 'ai_generation_records';
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_wallet_archived
    FROM public.account_deletion_archive_items AS i
    WHERE i.batch_id = v_batch_id AND i.source_table = 'wallet_transactions';
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_charge_source
    FROM public.chat_turn_charges AS c WHERE c.user_id = p_user_id;
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_charge_archived
    FROM public.account_deletion_archive_items AS i
    WHERE i.batch_id = v_batch_id AND i.source_table = 'chat_turn_charges';
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_event_source
    FROM public.chat_turn_events AS e WHERE e.user_id = p_user_id;
    SELECT count(*) INTO v_event_archived
    FROM public.account_deletion_archive_items AS i
    WHERE i.batch_id = v_batch_id AND i.source_table = 'chat_turn_events';

    IF v_ai_source <> v_ai_archived OR v_wallet_source <> v_wallet_archived
       OR v_charge_source <> v_charge_archived OR v_event_source <> v_event_archived
       OR EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM public.ai_generation_records AS a
         LEFT JOIN public.account_deletion_archive_items AS i
           ON i.batch_id = v_batch_id
          AND i.source_table = 'ai_generation_records'
          AND i.source_record_id = a.id::text
         WHERE a.user_id = p_user_id
           AND (i.id IS NULL OR i.payload IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.to_jsonb(a))
       )
       OR EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM public.wallet_transactions AS w
         LEFT JOIN public.account_deletion_archive_items AS i
           ON i.batch_id = v_batch_id
          AND i.source_table = 'wallet_transactions'
          AND i.source_record_id = w.id::text
         WHERE w.user_id = p_user_id
           AND (i.id IS NULL OR i.payload IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.to_jsonb(w))
       )
       OR EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM public.chat_turn_charges AS c
         LEFT JOIN public.account_deletion_archive_items AS i
           ON i.batch_id = v_batch_id
          AND i.source_table = 'chat_turn_charges'
          AND i.source_record_id = c.turn_id::text
         WHERE c.user_id = p_user_id
           AND (i.id IS NULL OR i.payload IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.to_jsonb(c))
       )
       OR EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM public.chat_turn_events AS e
         LEFT JOIN public.account_deletion_archive_items AS i
           ON i.batch_id = v_batch_id
          AND i.source_table = 'chat_turn_events'
          AND i.source_record_id = e.event_id::text
         WHERE e.user_id = p_user_id
           AND (i.id IS NULL OR i.payload IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.to_jsonb(e))
       ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION '既有封存批次與來源資料不一致，已停止刪除以避免資料遺失';
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.account_deletion_archive_batches AS b
    SET status = 'archived',
        attempt_count = b.attempt_count + 1,
        started_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp(),
        updated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp(),
        last_error = NULL
    WHERE b.id = v_batch_id;
  ELSE
    SELECT a.batch_id INTO v_batch_id
    FROM public.archive_account_deletion_data(p_user_id) AS a
    LIMIT 1;

    -- Preserve billing/audit rows as well as the original AI and wallet archive payloads.
    INSERT INTO public.account_deletion_archive_items
      (batch_id, source_table, source_record_id, payload)
    SELECT v_batch_id, 'chat_turn_charges', c.turn_id::text, pg_catalog.to_jsonb(c)
    FROM public.chat_turn_charges AS c
    WHERE c.user_id = p_user_id
    ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT account_deletion_archive_item_batch_id_source_table_source__key
    DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO public.account_deletion_archive_items
      (batch_id, source_table, source_record_id, payload)
    SELECT v_batch_id, 'chat_turn_events', e.event_id::text, pg_catalog.to_jsonb(e)
    FROM public.chat_turn_events AS e
    WHERE e.user_id = p_user_id
    ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT account_deletion_archive_item_batch_id_source_table_source__key
    DO NOTHING;

    v_status := 'archived';
  END IF;

  -- Verify billing/audit archive rows too before any irreversible deletion.
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_charge_source
  FROM public.chat_turn_charges AS c WHERE c.user_id = p_user_id;
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_charge_archived
  FROM public.account_deletion_archive_items AS i
  WHERE i.batch_id = v_batch_id AND i.source_table = 'chat_turn_charges';
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_event_source
  FROM public.chat_turn_events AS e WHERE e.user_id = p_user_id;
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_event_archived
  FROM public.account_deletion_archive_items AS i
  WHERE i.batch_id = v_batch_id AND i.source_table = 'chat_turn_events';

  IF v_charge_source <> v_charge_archived OR v_event_source <> v_event_archived
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.chat_turn_charges AS c
       LEFT JOIN public.account_deletion_archive_items AS i
         ON i.batch_id = v_batch_id
        AND i.source_table = 'chat_turn_charges'
        AND i.source_record_id = c.turn_id::text
       WHERE c.user_id = p_user_id
         AND (i.id IS NULL OR i.payload IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.to_jsonb(c))
     )
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.chat_turn_events AS e
       LEFT JOIN public.account_deletion_archive_items AS i
         ON i.batch_id = v_batch_id
        AND i.source_table = 'chat_turn_events'
        AND i.source_record_id = e.event_id::text
       WHERE e.user_id = p_user_id
         AND (i.id IS NULL OR i.payload IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.to_jsonb(e))
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '聊天扣款／事件紀錄封存核對失敗，已停止刪除';
  END IF;

  -- Archive verified: mark the irreversible phase before deleting source rows.
  UPDATE public.account_deletion_archive_batches AS b
  SET status = 'deleting',
      attempt_count = CASE WHEN b.attempt_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE b.attempt_count END,
      started_at = COALESCE(b.started_at, pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()),
      updated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp(),
      last_error = NULL
  WHERE b.id = v_batch_id;

  -- Remove non-cascading references before chat/profile/Auth deletion.
  DELETE FROM public.ai_generation_records WHERE user_id = p_user_id;

  -- Delete version history only for messages owned by the account being deleted.
  -- If this user edited another player's message, preserve that player's version rows
  -- and anonymize the editor reference instead of deleting someone else's history.
  DELETE FROM public.chat_message_versions AS v
  WHERE v.message_id IN (
    SELECT m.id
    FROM public.chat_messages AS m
    JOIN public.chat_sessions AS s ON s.id = m.session_id
    WHERE s.user_id = p_user_id
  );

  UPDATE public.chat_message_versions AS v
  SET edited_by = NULL
  WHERE v.edited_by = p_user_id
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.chat_messages AS m
      JOIN public.chat_sessions AS s ON s.id = m.session_id
      WHERE m.id = v.message_id
        AND s.user_id = p_user_id
    );

  -- user_message_id uses ON DELETE RESTRICT, so charges must be removed before messages.
  DELETE FROM public.chat_turn_charges WHERE user_id = p_user_id;

  DELETE FROM public.wallet_transactions WHERE user_id = p_user_id;

  -- Old conversation schema and role/chat data are owned by the profile; their declared
  -- CASCADE relationships remove stories, private info, conversations/messages and sessions.
  -- Explicitly remove conversations first so the cleanup is clear and retry-safe.
  DELETE FROM public.conversations WHERE user_id = p_user_id;

  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_batch_id, p_user_id, 'deleting'::text;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_account_deletion_failure(p_batch_id uuid, p_error_code text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_batch_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.account_deletion_archive_batches
  SET last_error = left(COALESCE(NULLIF(p_error_code, ''), 'worker_error'), 300),
      updated_at = pg_catalog.statement_timestamp(),
      attempt_count = attempt_count + 1
  WHERE id = p_batch_id
    AND status IN ('archived', 'deleting', 'failed');

  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_character_schedules(p_character_id uuid, p_schedules jsonb)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_count integer;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF p_character_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.characters c
    WHERE c.id = p_character_id
      AND c.author_id = v_uid
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Character not found or not owned by caller' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF p_schedules IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_schedules) <> 'array' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Schedules must be a JSON array' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  v_count := jsonb_array_length(p_schedules);
  IF v_count > 50 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'At most 50 schedule rows are allowed' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_schedules) AS e(value)
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.value) <> 'object'
      OR (e.value ? 'weekday' AND e.value->'weekday' <> 'null'::jsonb
          AND (jsonb_typeof(e.value->'weekday') <> 'number'
               OR (e.value->>'weekday') !~ '^[0-6]$'))
      OR COALESCE(e.value->>'day_type', 'any') NOT IN ('any', 'weekday', 'weekend')
      OR COALESCE(e.value->>'start_time', '') !~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'
      OR COALESCE(e.value->>'end_time', '') !~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'
      OR COALESCE(e.value->>'start_time', '') = COALESCE(e.value->>'end_time', '')
      OR COALESCE(e.value->>'location_key', '') !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}$'
      OR char_length(COALESCE(e.value->>'activity', '')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 300
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'One or more schedule rows are invalid' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- Transactional replacement: any insertion error rolls the deletion back as well.
  DELETE FROM public.character_schedules
  WHERE character_id = p_character_id;

  INSERT INTO public.character_schedules (
    character_id, weekday, day_type, start_time, end_time,
    location_key, activity, priority, is_active
  )
  SELECT
    p_character_id,
    x.weekday,
    COALESCE(x.day_type, 'any'),
    x.start_time::time,
    x.end_time::time,
    x.location_key,
    x.activity,
    0,
    true
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset(p_schedules) AS x(
    weekday smallint,
    day_type text,
    start_time text,
    end_time text,
    location_key text,
    activity text
  );

  RETURN v_count;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.soft_delete_chat_memory_photo(p_photo_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(storage_path text, chat_type text, session_id uuid, group_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF NOT public.account_is_active() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'account deletion pending' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  UPDATE public.chat_memory_photos AS p
     SET status = 'deleting',
         deleted_at = pg_catalog.now()
   WHERE p.id = p_photo_id
     AND p.owner_id = v_uid
     AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
  RETURNING p.storage_path, p.chat_type, p.session_id, p.group_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'photo not found or not owned by current user' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.chat_groups AS g
     SET background_mode = 'none',
         background_memory_photo_id = NULL,
         updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
   WHERE g.background_memory_photo_id = p_photo_id
     AND g.owner_id = v_uid;
END;
$function$
